title: Propose Day special landing page

requirements.text: Create a responsive, single-page “Propose Day” special webpage with a romantic hero section (headline, short subtext, primary call-to-action button) and clear scrolling structure (hero, message section, reasons/notes section, proposal question section, footer).
acceptanceCriteria: Page renders as a cohesive single-page experience on desktop and mobile without horizontal scrolling
Hero section includes a prominent headline, 1–2 lines of supporting text, and a primary CTA button
Content is organized into distinct sections with consistent spacing and typography

requirements.text: Add an interactive “Will you be mine?” proposal section that supports a simple, client-side interaction: clicking “Yes” shows a celebratory confirmation state; clicking “Not yet” shows a gentle, non-blocking secondary state encouraging reconsideration. Keep all interactions purely client-side (no persistence required).
acceptanceCriteria: Proposal section includes at minimum two buttons: “Yes” and “Not yet”
Clicking “Yes” transitions to a visible confirmation state (e.g., message card, animation, or banner)
Clicking “Not yet” shows a polite message without breaking layout or navigation
Reloading the page resets the interaction state (no backend storage)

requirements.text: Apply a coherent visual theme for a romantic “Propose Day” page (avoid blue/purple). Define and use a consistent palette, typography scale, spacing, and decorative elements across all sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme uses a romantic palette (e.g., blush/rose/cream with warm accent like gold) and is applied consistently across sections
Buttons, cards, and headings follow a consistent component style
All user-facing text is in English

requirements.text: Add required generated images as static assets and incorporate them into the page design (e.g., hero background/illustration, heart motif). Store them under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them directly from the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist in frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames
The page loads and displays the images without routing through the backend
Images are responsive (scale/crop appropriately) and do not cause layout shift

constraints: Frontend must use React + TypeScript with Tailwind and Shadcn components (compose UI components; do not modify read-only UI component sources).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other immutable paths provided by the platform.
Backend changes are not required for this request; keep the solution client-side unless explicitly needed later.
nonGoals: User accounts, authentication, or Internet Identity flows
Persisting proposal responses or sending notifications/emails
Multi-page site, admin panels, or CMS editing

required: Romantic hero background illustration with soft gradients, subtle bokeh, and heart motifs (propose-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
Minimal elegant heart emblem/icon with a warm accent color (heart-emblem.dim_512x512.png)
Small repeating heart pattern tile, subtle and low-contrast (heart-pattern-tile.dim_512x512.png)

preferencesToAdd: Use English for all user-facing text.
